summary: Seer learns a predictive inverse-dynamics policy that produces robot actions conditioned on forecast visual states. It is pretrained on robot demonstrations and evaluated through simulation and real-world manipulation, including robustness and generalization tests.

name: Video Prediction Policy
title: Video Prediction Policy: A Generalist Robot Policy with Predictive Visual Representations
summary: Video Prediction Policy uses representations inside a video diffusion model to condition an implicit inverse-dynamics policy. It adapts the video model with robot and human-manipulation data and evaluates generalization and dexterous manipulation in simulated and physical tasks.

name: Unified World Models
title: Unified World Models: Coupling Video and Action Diffusion for Pretraining on Large Robotic Datasets
summary: Unified World Models couples video and action diffusion in one transformer using separate diffusion timesteps for the two modalities. This supports policy, forward-dynamics, inverse-dynamics, and video-generation modes, including learning from action-free video.
